# Parameter registry findings

V2-P06 and V2-P07 each recorded one of these and neither fixed it. They are recomputed here from the cards and the calibration code, so the numbers are not quoted from a report; the resolutions below are the only ones this phase is allowed to take.

- declared calibration parameters: 13
- explicitly excluded cards: 4
- cards carrying a `range:` block: 37
- of which in neither list: 19 with numeric bounds and 1 text-only
- cards with no range at all: 85

## 1. A central value outside its own range

| parameter | finding |
| --- | --- |
| interest_rate_monthly | the card records 0.005, below its own range [0.01, 0.1] |

The prior is the range, so this parameter's prior cannot contain the value the model runs; the sensitivity stage holds it at the nearest endpoint instead. The conflict is not recorded on the card: its `range.conflicts` field is empty.

## 3. Declared priors the calibration simulator does not rebuild

| parameter |
| --- |
| pay_tael_per_soldier_month |
| food_shi_per_soldier_month |

`SandboxSimulator.parameter_sets` rebuilds one parameter set per name in its own `_DEFAULTS` table, and that table holds BandParameters, CropParameters, EliteParameters, FiscalParameters, HouseholdParameters, MarketParameters, MigrationParameters. A draw on a parameter outside it passes `_check`, enters `parameter_hash` and is dropped before the run: the value is recorded as an input and is not one.

## Resolutions taken in this phase

| finding | parameters | resolution |

| central value outside its own declared range | interest_rate_monthly | registered carried item |
| range-carrying cards in neither the declared nor the excluded list | foreclosure_after_unserviced_months, foreclosure_land_share_of_pledge, arrears_recovery_share, arrears_recovery_silver_months, arrears_remission_share, arrears_remission_unmet_ratio, arrears_settlement_share, crop_saturation_events, crop_weight, drought_saturation_events, drought_weight, famine_saturation_events, famine_weight, pest_saturation_events, pest_weight, demand_pressure_cap, demand_pressure_weight, destitution_departure_share, destitution_exit_share | registered carried item |
| a card whose range block carries no bounds | monthly_allocation_profile | registered carried item |
| declared priors whose parameter set the simulator does not rebuild | pay_tael_per_soldier_month, food_shi_per_soldier_month | registered carried item, and a defect rather than a registry choice |

### Why not the other two routes

- **central value outside its own declared range** — P10 may not move the central, exclude the parameter (that would change the prior table and the frozen posterior's prior_digest), or edit the card (that would change data/parameters/*.yaml, which evidence_digest covers and the frozen outputs/v2/p06/posterior.json records).
- **range-carrying cards in neither the declared nor the excluded list** — 19 of the 37 range-carrying cards need an exclusion rule each, and no measurement in this phase produces one; registering the gap is the honest action, and inventing the rules is not available to this phase.
- **a card whose range block carries no bounds** — it is not a drawable range, so it is neither a prior nor an excludable card; excluded_parameters refuses a card with no bounded range by design.
- **declared priors whose parameter set the simulator does not rebuild** — the draw is checked, hashed into the run identity and then dropped before the run, so those priors are declared and ineffective; changing it changes what the frozen posterior means, which is not this phase's to change.
